data.body:
rebar-debug Phase 2 complete — fix up for review as Gerrit change 2118.

PROVEN ROOT CAUSE: sign_manifest's generation loop (generation.py:289-291) treated
a transient store-read-failure from its pre-lock reads as terminal, while the
sibling moving-HEAD transient is retried. A peer session's in-flight git add->commit
staged index makes `git status --untracked-files=no` non-empty -> store-read-failure.
(Full RCA + runtime proof in the earlier RCA comment.)

DEFECT ORIGIN: commit 94e605a29d2, ticket 5967-4476-7f9f-442d ("Add phased
plan-review attestations") — introduced the asymmetric handler. caused_by link
recorded; will pass --caused-by=5967-4476-7f9f-442d --class=plan_defect on close.

TEST (held-out RED->GREEN): tests/unit/test_plan_review_sign_transaction.py
- test_transient_store_read_failure_is_retried_then_signs (transient -> signs)
- test_persistent_store_read_failure_is_retryable_not_terminal (exhaustion -> retryable)
Both confirmed RED first (PlanReviewGenerationError at generation.py:291), GREEN after
fix, and have teeth (mutation: reverting the fix returns both to RED). Assertions are on
observable behavior (return value / exception type), not internals.

FIX: retry a store-read-failure within MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS (continue, mirroring the
moving-HEAD path); on exhaustion the loop raises the retryable PlanReviewGenerationRetryable.
Deterministic reasons stay terminal. The under-lock re-check remains the fence, so retrying
the pre-lock reads is safe.

SCOPE & SAFETY: single-site non-test change (17 lines, generation.py). Caller-dependency
gate: the only catcher (plan_review/__init__.py:530) records the exception's fields into the
verdict signature uniformly; no caller depends on store-read-failure being terminal. Making a
persistent one retryable aligns it with the existing moving-HEAD exhaustion path (already
PlanReviewGenerationRetryable). Restoration not creation; no new dependency; no test weakened.
lint + complexity ratchet + mypy + 46 targeted plan-review tests all green.

SIBLINGS (Step 7):
- Axis 1 (construct): the only signing-loop terminal catch is the fixed site; the
  relation_snapshot.py catches are inside snapshot collection, not siblings.
- Axis 2 (parity): completion-verifier close signing goes through signing.sign_manifest ->
  _sign_manifest_under_lock (reads UNDER the store lock, so no concurrent staging window) —
  structurally immune, N/A. sign-review/resign.py:179 has a parity gap in its pre-signing
  baseline collect() -> filed 90c1-c112-d076-4c96 (flirty-insulting-bullfrog),
  discovered_from this bug.

REPLICATION: the reported scenario (review-plan PASS but signing aborts) no longer
reproduces — review-plan on THIS bug ran from the fixed worktree and returned a SIGNED PASS
(signature.signed=True), the exact behavior the report says was impossible.

RESIDUAL: the abort/remedy message text ("repair or remove the plan relationship") is
misleading for a transient contention failure but is emitted by the caller, not the defect
site; accepted (not the proven defect) — noted for follow-up alongside the resign sibling.

Pending: Gerrit 2118 LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, then Submit, then close with attribution.
